item.title: Free presentation on dealing with dementia at Village Church in RSF
item.description: Dealing with dementia is a pressing challenge, especially amongst those with loved ones at later stages of life. The Village Church Care Ministry hopes to support these needs with a free, hour-long interactive educational presentation on Wednesday, March 11, at 6:30 p.m. in the church parlor. Attendees will hear from Shannon Brandon, a concierge geriatric care manager with Arosa.
